a16z-Backed Layer 1 Project Linera Announces Shutdown The Linera team announced on Discord that it is ceasing operations immediately due to insufficient funding. Its token sale on Sonar attracted nearly $900,000 in commitments but missed the minimum threshold, and all contributions have been refunded. Emergency funding efforts also failed. Linera is winding down its app and Discord community. Points balances will remain on record, but no future benefits are guaranteed. The team still hopes to complete the protocol and launch applications, though no timeline is available. Founded by former Meta researcher Mathieu Baudet, Linera raised approximately $12 million across two rounds in 2022 and 2023, with a16z participating in both. Other investors included Borderless Capital, GSR, Matrixport Ventures, and Flow Traders. — link

Highlight Clip: Circle CPTO: If Hundreds of Millions in USDC Are Stolen, Would Arc Be Rolled Back? Circle CPTO: If Hundreds of Millions in USDC Are Stolen, Would Arc Be Rolled Back? Circle Chief Product and Technology Officer Nikhil Chandhok said in a September 16 interview with Bankless that, when asked whether Circle would roll back Arc if a lending protocol such as Aave were exploited by the Lazarus Group and tens or even hundreds of millions of dollars in USDC were stolen, he could not commit to a specific response.Instead, Chandhok emphasized that Arc is immutable public financial infrastructure supported by more than 20 validators. He said rolling back a blockchain would be an extremely significant decision, and breaking its immutability could fundamentally undermine trust that would be difficult to rebuild. — link

Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs Record $433 Million and $144 Million in Net Inflows on Sept. 18 (ET) On Sept. 18 (ET), spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded total net inflows of $433 million, led by Fidelity's FBTC with $311 million, followed by BlackRock's IBIT with $108 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs recorded total net inflows of $144 million, led by BlackRock's ETHA with $114 million, followed by Fidelity's FETH with $26.2449 million. — link

Highlight Clip: Tom Lee: We've Been Advocating a 2% Crypto Position Tom Lee: We've Been Advocating a 2% Crypto Position Description: On September 11, 2026, BitMine Chairman Tom Lee said in an interview with Wealthion that he has long advocated a 2% crypto position for investors with no crypto exposure. He noted that for some Fundstrat clients who followed the recommendation, the original 2% allocation has grown to more than 85% of their portfolios due to Bitcoin’s substantial price appreciation, rather than additional purchases. Lee believes that over the next decade, crypto could provide exposure with relatively low correlation to other assets, benefit from the growth of AI, and become an important part of how the financial services industry reinvents itself. WuBlockchain notes that Tom Lee's market forecasts tend to be optimistic. His bullish targets may not materialize, and actual market performance may differ significantly from his predictions. Readers are encouraged to focus on his analytical reasoning rather than use specific price targets or timelines as a basis for investment decisions. — link
